title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Gridware

Gridware is a San Francisco-based technology company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the electrical grid. We pioneered a groundbreaking new class of grid management called active grid response (AGR), focused on monitoring the electrical, physical, and environmental aspects of the grid that affect reliability and safety. Gridware ’s advanced Active Grid Response platform uses high-precision sensors to detect potential issues early, enabling proactive maintenance and fault mitigation. This comprehensive approach helps improve safety, reduce outages, and ensure the grid operates efficiently. The company is backed by climate-tech and Silicon Valley investors. For more information, please visit www. Gridware .io.
Team Overview
The Customer Success team is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our utility customers. This team ensures that customers maximize the value of Gridware ’s technology by providing technical expertise, proactive support, and strategic guidance. Acting as the voice of the customer within the company, Customer Success collaborates across sales, engineering, product, and operations teams to enhance customer experience and drive long-term partnerships.
You must be located in CST or EST for this role.
Role Description
The Customer Success Manager will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with utility customers, ensuring they receive maximum value from Gridware ’s solutions. This role involves deeply understanding utility customer needs and educating stakeholders on fault detection and grid monitoring capabilities. Additionally, this role will lead use case development, pilot program design, and the creation of success metrics to validate system performance.
The ideal candidate will possess:

• Expertise in electric grid operations and/or utility dispatch processes;

• The ability to communicate complex concepts across a broad range of stakeholders within utilities;

• A strong orientation toward customer experience, relationship management, and operational support.

Responsibilities

• Act as the primary contact for utility customers, building trusted relationships, understanding their needs, and providing onboarding and training to maximize Gridware ’s technology.

• Help customers interpret grid events, improve response strategies, integrate solutions into workflows, and develop documentation for troubleshooting.

• Create tailored training materials, lead pilot programs with defined KPIs, and collaborate on new use cases aligned with industry needs.

• Drive adoption, retention, and satisfaction through success strategies, establish KPIs for customer health, and track performance analytics.

• Partner with sales, product, and field teams for seamless support, relay customer insights to engineering, and troubleshoot issues effectively.

Required Skills

• 7+ years of experience in customer success, program management, technical account management, or operations within the electric utility or grid technology sector.

• Deep understanding of electric grid operations and utility crew dispatch processes.

• Strong customer relationship management skills, with a track record of managing complex utility accounts.

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distill complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.

Bonus Skills

• Prior experience working in a customer-facing role at a grid technology or sensor-based monitoring company.

• Familiarity with SCADA systems, AMI networks, or other utility communication platforms.

• Experience leading customer training sessions, webinars, or technical workshops.

• Technical proficiency in interpreting grid monitoring data, fault detection signals, and utility response workflows.

• Strong data analysis skills to assess system performance and customer usage trends.

• A background in engineering or technical support related to grid operations.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
About the Organization

EnGen offers an at-scale, AI-powered approach to English instruction, designed to solve a systemic access issue: Adult English learners now represent 1 in 10 working-age adults in the U.S., yet the workforce system serves the needs of just 4% of these workers.
A Certified B Corporation, EnGen is filling the gap by partnering with employers, adult educators, workforce development organizations, and state governments to connect job seekers and incumbent workers with English skills, career pathways, and employment in high-demand industries. EnGen 's workforce-aligned approach addresses employers' recruitment and retention challenges and advances learners' economic mobility.
Position Overview
We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to help build the technology that empowers adult English learners to achieve their career goals. You'll develop and enhance our AI-powered learning platform using TypeScript/React on the frontend and Python/FastAPI on the backend.
We expect our engineers to be fluent in AI-assisted development - using tools like Cursor and Claude Code to write, review, and ship code faster and at higher quality. You should be comfortable directing AI to generate code, critically evaluating what it produces, and knowing when to write it yourself.
Full-Stack Development

• Deliver production software across our TypeScript/React frontend and Python/FastAPI backend - whether writing code directly or steering AI tools to generate it

• Build responsive web applications for diverse learners across desktop and mobile

• Design and implement scalable APIs to support our learning platform

• Develop real-time features for interactive lessons, conversation practice, and learner-coach communication

AI/LLM Integration

• Integrate Large Language Models for content classification, skill assessment, learner feedback, and personalization

• Build information extraction systems to analyze learner responses

• Implement AI-powered features for conversation practice and multilingual support

Development Excellence

• Write clean, well-tested code - and apply the same rigor when reviewing AI-generated output

• Actively use and refine AI-assisted development workflows to improve your own productivity

• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and education specialists

• Contribute to A/B testing frameworks and learning experience optimization

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional full-stack web development experience

• Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, Python, and FastAPI

• Experience integrating with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for classification, extraction, or personalization

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) - and genuine comfort using them as part of your daily workflow

• Experience with PostgreSQL and API design

• Strong passion for EnGen 's mission to help immigrants and refugees remove English as a barrier to career advancement

• Self-directed and able to work independently in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience building edtech or language learning platforms

• Knowledge of NLP and educational AI applications

• Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards

• Experience with Railway, Cloudflare, or similar cloud infrastructure

• Multilingual capabilities, particularly Spanish

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and equity

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

• Flexible PTO and fully remote environment

• Professional development budget

• Mission-driven work with measurable real-world impact

Ready to use technology to break down language barriers and create economic opportunities? Join us in building the future of workforce English instruction.

title: HCC Clinical Documentation Specialist

At UASI , we're driven by a mission to improve the quality and accuracy of clinical documentation through expert CDI consulting. As we continue to grow our service offerings, we’re looking for experienced and motivated HCC Clinical Documentation Specialists to join our dedicated team in a fully remote capacity.
As an HCC Clinical Documentation Specialist, this individual will play a critical role in supporting coding accuracy, HCC capture, regulatory compliance, and clinical documentation integrity. This role requires strong clinical judgment, analytical skills, and a commitment to advancing documentation excellence that reflects the patient's true severity of illness and complexity of care.
Key Responsibilities

• Serves as a subject matter expert in clinical documentation quality, risk adjustment, and HCC coding integrity in the outpatient setting.

• Performs prospective reviews of medical records from physician practices, outpatient settings, and relevant inpatient encounters to validate chronic conditions and ensure documentation accuracy, clinical integrity, appropriate coding, and HCC capture.

• Utilizes Epic, OurPractice Advisories (OPAs) to perform prospective chart reviews, identify documentation opportunities, validate chronic conditions, and support accurate coding, HCC capture, and clinical documentation integrity initiatives.

• Track and manage work queues, review inventories, and OPA-related activities to ensure timely follow-up, productivity targets, and accurate completion of CDI interventions.

• Monitor, analyze, and report CDI outcomes, documentation trends, and HCC recapture performance to identify improvement opportunities and support program goals.

Qualifications:

• Minimum 2 years of ambulatory Clinical Documentation Integrity, Risk Adjustment, or related healthcare documentation experience

• Active LPN or RN license required

• CCDS, CCDS-O, CDIP, CDEO and/or CRC certification strongly preferred

• Proficiency in Epic workflows, including interpretation and management of OurPractice Advisories (OPAs) preferred

• Strong understanding of: ICD-10-CM coding guidelines, HCC documentation and coding requirements

title: Head of Growth Marketing
description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is a global payments infrastructure with deep emerging markets expertise. Businesses use us to access US dollars, manage treasury, and move money across borders.

Our focus now is scaling our dollar account product for businesses, a single account to hold dollars and stablecoins, manage treasury, and collect and disburse local currencies, and deepening the payment rails and currency coverage behind it.

The Role

You will own how we generate and convert B2B demand: paid, ABM, and outbound, plus the data, systems, and handoffs that connect all three to pipeline.

Our buyers are treasurers, treasury directors, and CFOs at large multinationals. Cycles are long, buying committees have several people in them, and our target accounts are named and finite. Depth inside a known list of accounts matters more than volume.

Marketing is a small team, so how you build matters as much as what you run. We are looking for someone who automates their own function rather than absorbing more manual work as the program grows: workflows that handle research, enrichment, list building, routing, and reporting, so your time goes to judgment and strategy. If your instinct when a task repeats is to build something that does it for you, this is the right seat.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will own the marketing-sourced pipeline number and be measured on cost efficiency as well as volume.

What you'll do

• Run paid acquisition. Paid search, paid social, and retargeting, in the platforms yourself rather than through an agency. Move budget toward whatever produces qualified pipeline at the best cost per lead.

• Own the ABM program. Execute against named accounts in commodities, logistics, mining, FMCG, pharmaceutical, and manufacturing. Build and tier the lists with sales, then run plays across ads, email, content, and outbound.

• Build the outbound motion with sales: sequencing, messaging, list building, deliverability, and the tooling behind it.

• Design the system, not just the campaigns. With marketing operations, own the model connecting spend to pipeline: what counts as qualified, the scoring and routing logic, campaign taxonomy, handoff thresholds with sales, and tracking at every stage. When a channel underperforms, you should be able to point to the stage that broke.

• Automate your own function. Build the workflows that take repetitive work off your plate: account research and enrichment, list building, lead routing and alerting, campaign reporting, and first-draft copy and creative production. We use n8n, Claude, and Salesforce, and we treat this as core to the role rather than a side experiment. We would rather you spend a week building something that runs forever than do the task manually for a year.

• Grow the supporting channels: nurture email, webinars, event follow-up, and landing-page conversion. Organic and AI search is an active channel for us, and you will coordinate with the content function on it.

• Own the numbers. Cost per lead, cost per MQL, stage conversion, and pipeline contribution. You will own the definitions, not just the dashboards.

What we're looking for

• Experience in B2B demand generation, growth, or performance marketing, with hands-on ownership of paid channels.

• Pipeline you can point to, with a real handle on cost per lead and return on spend.

• Experience running an ABM program against named accounts alongside sales.

• Systems thinking. Evidence you have built the plumbing and not just the campaigns: lead scoring, routing rules, campaign taxonomy, attribution logic, or reporting models. Tell us about one you built or fixed.

• Workflow automation. Automations you have built that took work off your plate, whether in n8n, Make, Zapier, Clay, or scripts, wired into a CRM or ad platform. Tell us what you built, what it replaced, and what still needs a human.

• Fluency with funnel data. You can define a metric as well as read one, and you make budget calls f

title: Scientist II/Senior Melt Polymer Scientist
description:
Your Impact at LILA

As a Scientist II/Senior Melt Polymer Scientist on the Materials Formulation team at Lila Sciences, you will drive the development and optimization of solid polymers, such as hot melt adhesive systems, working at the intersection of polymer science, formulation chemistry, and Lila's autonomous science platform. You will design and execute high-throughput melt processing and characterization experiments that generate critical rheological, chemical, and mechanical data to guide adhesive formulation and materials discovery. Working alongside experimentalists, engineers, and machine learning scientists, you will build scalable polymer processing and testing workflows that accelerate the path to scientific superintelligence in solid polymer materials.

What You'll Be Building

• Lead AI-driven experimental design and analysis to optimize solid polymer formulations, such as hot melt adhesives, leveraging polymer extrusion and melt processing techniques to translate formulation targets into manufacturable products.

• Develop and apply melt rheology methods to characterize processability and application performance of solid polymer systems.

• Conduct polymer characterization studies (e.g., molecular weight, thermal transitions, crystallinity) to establish structure-property relationships that inform formulation strategy.

• Design and execute mechanical testing protocols, including peel, shear, tack, and bond strength, to evaluate formulation performance against application requirements.

• Collaborate with experimentalists, systems engineers, and ML scientists to integrate characterization outputs into autonomous closed-loop workflows and ML training datasets.

• Troubleshoot characterization workflows and instrumentation to sustain high-throughput operational performance.

• Maintain accurate laboratory records and ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• PhD in Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field, with 3+ years of postdoctoral or industry experience (or equivalent industry experience with an advanced degree).

• Demonstrated expertise in melt polymer formulation and development, including hands-on experience with polymer extrusion and melt processing equipment.

• Strong working knowledge of melt rheology and proficiency with rheometers, melt flow indexers, or equivalent platforms.

• Experience with polymer characterization techniques including DSC, GPC/SEC, or FTIR, and mechanical testing methods (peel, shear, tack, tensile, lap shear) on relevant ASTM/industry test standards.

• Proficient in quantitative data analysis and interpretation of process-structure-property relationships in polymeric materials.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills with a track record of cross-functional collaboration.

Bonus Points For

• Background across multiple polymer chemistries, and familiarity with adhesive raw material classes, including base polymers, tackifying resins, waxes, and stabilizer/additive packages.

• Experience with pilot-scale or production-scale extrusion, coating, or hot melt application equipment for different polymer product classes.

• Proficiency in Python or similar tools for data analysis and workflow automation.

• Exposure to automated, high-throughput, or autonomous laboratory environments, such as custom or automated rheological and mechanical test instrumentation.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Authentication and authorization underpin nearly every interaction on Vinted. They determine how members, employees, and services prove who they are, and what they are allowed to do.

Today, these responsibilities span our core platform, dedicated identity services, gateways, service-mesh infrastructure, and workforce systems. We are evolving this landscape towards a shared identity model and an authorization platform that is secure, reliable, observable, and straightforward for engineering teams to adopt.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer II to join the Authentication and Authorization team. You’ll work across two connected areas:

• Evolving authentication towards a consistent, federated identity model for members, employees, and systems

• Building shared authorization capabilities that replace fragmented, service-specific solutions with common concepts, APIs, tooling, and decision observability

This is neither a purely greenfield role nor a legacy-maintenance role. You’ll help extract existing functionality safely, improve production services, and build new platform capabilities.

We’re looking for an experienced engineer, but not necessarily someone who already knows every part of identity and access management. What matters is strong engineering judgement, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and domains. You should be comfortable going deep into a technical problem, then zooming out to understand how the solution affects users, services, infrastructure, security, and other engineering teams.

In this position, you’ll 

• Design, build, and operate backend services supporting authentication, identity propagation, token exchange, authorization decisions, and policy management

• Help extract authentication functionality from existing systems while preserving feature parity, controlling rollout risk, and retiring legacy paths safely

• Contribute to stable identity and authorization contracts that allow services to evolve without depending on individual identity providers, token formats, or API implementations

• Build shared authorization capabilities, including a capability registry, policy APIs, decision logs, and tools for understanding who or what can access a resource

• Improve supported integration paths - such as SDKs, libraries, conformance tests, documentation, and migration tooling - that make secure adoption easier for other teams

• Work with Registration, Platform, Security, and product-domain engineers to define owner

En juillet 2026, Qonto a racheté Acasi pour construire la première offre bancaire et comptable vraiment intégrée pour les entrepreneurs. Notre conviction : les entrepreneurs méritent une comptabilité certifiée, intégrée directement à leurs outils, pilotée par des pros qui ont du temps pour conseiller plutôt que pour saisir. L'IA automatise ce qui peut l'être, et le métier se déplace vers ce qui a toujours eu le plus de valeur : le conseil et la relation client. 
En tant que Collaborateur Comptable Expérimenté ou Mémorialiste, tu rejoindras une équipe en hypercroissance au cœur de cette transformation, avec un portefeuille de clients indépendants à piloter en autonomie et un rôle actif dans l'évolution de notre solution.
➡️ Ce que tu feras
Conseil de confiance : Tu es l'interlocuteur principal de tes clients sur leurs enjeux fiscaux, financiers, juridiques et comptables - pas un exécutant, un référent. Parmi eux, une variété de dossiers comme des professions libérales, consultants, développeurs, RH indépendants, entreprises d’e-commerce, agents immobiliers ou encore holdings.
Pilote ton portefeuille : Tu prends en charge la tenue, la révision et les obligations fiscales de tes clients (TVA, liasses fiscales, dépôt des comptes), avec des outils pensés pour aller vite sur ce qui peut être automatisé.
Façonne notre produit : Tu es le lien entre tes clients et notre équipe produit. Leurs retours, leurs frustrations, leurs besoins - tu les remontres directement et tu participes à l'évolution de la solution Acasi.
Contribues aux clôtures : Tu travailles en équipe sur les clôtures comptables périodiques, en veillant à la cohérence et à la fiabilité des comptes.
Mentoring : Tu participes à la formation de nos profils juniors et fais office de mentor pour eux.
➡️ Ce qu'on recherche
Formation comptable : DSCG, Master CCA, ou EC mémorialiste - à n'importe quelle étape de ton parcours.
Une première expérience en cabinet : 3 ans minimum. Tu connais le rythme des échéances et tu es force de proposition pour ton équipe.
Appétence pour le digital et l'IA : Tu t'intéresses à ce que la technologie change dans le métier - et tu veux travailler dans un cabinet qui en fait un avantage, pas un sujet de peur.
Envie de construire quelque chose : Acasi n'est pas un cabinet figé. Tu veux participer à ce qui se construit - pas juste occuper un poste.
Langues : français courant indispensable pour la relation client. Anglais B1 minimum - nos équipes et nos outils sont en partie en anglais.
➡️ Ce qu'on t'offre
Être au cœur du réacteur : L'IA va transformer la comptabilité plus vite que n'importe quel autre

title: GTM Engineer - Revenue Operations
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Baseten's GTM org is in hyper growth. As it grows and matures, the needs of the GTM stack get more sophisticated with scale - and this team exists to stay ahead of those needs. Our GTM Engineering team plays a critical role in building and maintaining the connective tissue across Baseten’s GTM tools, processes, and user experience for the field.

The GTM tooling landscape is changing fast, and the teams that win are the ones that adapt and iterate the fastest. This role exists to make sure Baseten is one of them.

You'll design, build, and ship AI-powered workflows that scale our GTM functions as a competitive advantage. We want someone who can walk in, audit what we have, identify what we're missing, and start shipping fast.

You know when to reach for Clay and when to build something custom in Claude Code. You think two to three steps ahead about how the thing you build today fits into the broader systems architecture tomorrow. And you bring a point of view - on our stack, on what we should be building, and on where AI can do something low-code tooling simply can't.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Ship AI-powered workflows for the field - build the agents and automations that give reps and managers real leverage, off-loading the manual and repetitive work. Reach for AI where it does something low-code can't.

- Get insights in front of reps - turn Salesforce, warehouse, and usage data into the dashboards, scores, and alerts reps actually act on. A build isn't done until the field is using it.

- Audit the stack and generate your own backlog - we have a lot of tools, some overlap, and real gaps. Walk in with a point of view, identify what's missing or broken, and prioritize without waiting to be handed a roadmap.

- Ship rep-productivity workflows fast - triage asks from the field, find the low-hanging fruit, and build it. A good week looks like a VP of Sales asking for something Monday and having it live by Wednesday.

- Know when to go custom - not everything belongs in a point-and-click tool. Spin up bespoke AI-powered solutions in Claude Code when the problem calls for it, and make that call with judgment, not default.

- Think in systems, not solutions - every workflow you build has upstream and downstream implications. Anticipate them, design for them, and don't create technical debt that someone else has to unwind six months later.

- Integrate third-party APIs to sync events and information across disparate systems - ensuring data flows reliably between the tools your team depends on every day.

- Document what you build - if people can't find it, understand it, or trust it, it doesn't matter how well it works.

REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years of experience in GTM Engineering, workflow automation, or a technical RevOps role - ideally at a high-growth, AI-native B2B company

- You’ve shipped production agents on Vercel - build custom internal GTM apps and agents on Vercel, with durable workflows and sandboxed execution, so what you ship runs reliably in production instead of as one-off scripts

- Genuine fluency with AI coding assistants and agent tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) - you're actively building with these tools in production, not just experimenting

- Hands-on experience with Clay as a primary enrichment and workflow tool - you have opinions about how to use it well and you've pushed it to its limit

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced and driven Senior IT Engineer to serve as a senior technical contributor on Posit's IT Operations team, supporting our distributed workforce, corporate systems, and enterprise AI infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a seasoned systems administrator and support engineer who has moved beyond day-to-day ticket response and is ready to take ownership of critical platforms, lead cross-team technical efforts, and mentor more junior team members. You'll play a leading role in operating our IT infrastructure, raising the bar on our processes and documentation, and ensuring the productivity and security of our employees. IT Operations owns and runs the platforms everything else rides on - identity, endpoints, SaaS systems, the enterprise AI platform, and the infrastructure for our enterprise automation platform. Our department's mission is to empower Posit's employees with reliable technology, maintain a robust IT environment, and operate the platform foundation for the company's enterprise AI program. You will collaborate closely with other teams across the organization to achieve our departmental mission. We achieve this through proactive system management, responsive user support, code-driven operations, and continuous process improvement, enabling innovation with effective IT solutions. Since its inception, Posit has operated as a 100% distributed company with a SaaS-first infrastructure, complemented by select platforms we host and manage ourselves in AWS. This presents unique challenges and requires pragmatism, creativity, and a collaborative, detail-oriented approach to be successful.
You will own:

• End-to-end ownership of one or more core IT platforms (platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, Jamf Pro, Zoom, Slack, or the infrastructure for automation platforms such as n8n, Workato, or Okta Workflows) - including configuration, health, security posture, and roadmap. For the automation platform, that means the platform itself - hosting, upgrades, access, backups, and monitoring - while IT Engineering builds the workflows within it. While most of our stack is SaaS, some platforms are self-hosted in AWS, and that infrastructure is ours to run.

• Complex technical escalations across end user devices (Mac, Windows, Linux) and SaaS applications, serving as the senior point of contact when issues exceed the scope of Tier 1 support.

• Design and implementation of meaningful improvements to employee technology workflows - onboarding, offboarding, device lifecycle, access provisioning with scalability at the forefront.

• Day-to-day operational ownership of Posit's enterprise AI platform and its supporting integrations, including SSO/SCIM health, license management, desktop deployment via MDM, and front-line support for complex issues.

• Technical mentorship of IT Engineers - pairing on tickets, reviewing pull requests, and leveling up the team's technical practices.

• Maintenance of SaaS configurations, end user device controls, system access controls, and patch management according to approved guidelines, with a high bar for security and compliance.

• Creation and upkeep of technical documentation, runbooks, and playbooks for the systems and processes you own.

• Leading scheduled audits of IT-controlled systems and coordinating remediation of findings.

• Driving IT's GitOps practice forward - managing meaningful portions of your owned systems through version-controlled code, pull requests, and peer review, and coaching others through the same workflow.

You will assist with:

• Defining and refining IT's engineering standards, including IaC patterns, code review expectations, and exception processes.

• Contributing to procurement, vendor evaluation, and technical assessments for new tools - with a clear eye toward automation, support for configuration as code, and integration with our existing stack.

• Enforcing procedures for safeguarding information security and safety within IT procedures.

ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Please note we are looking for someone who is willing and able to come into our downtown San Francisco office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).

YOUR ROLE

We're hiring a Senior/Principal Product Manager (experience dependent) to lead Zip's Contract Orchestration product, one of the company's newest and most strategic bets. Buy-side contracting is still broken: reviews and redlines live in email threads, signed agreements disappear into shared drives, and requesters call the process a black box. Zip's customers execute over a million contract reviews a year and most of them are routine agreements. We just launched AI Contract Orchestration to take that work off legal and procurement, and there is far more to build.

You'll own the vision and strategy for one or more areas of this product, end to end and with a high degree of autonomy. The category is established, but Zip has an edge: as the front door for procurement, we see every contract with clean intake data on the requester, spend, category, and risk, so our AI can review clauses, propose redlines, and route work on real context rather than the document alone. As PM, you'll balance different users' interests throughout the contracting process (procurement, legal, finance, requesters, suppliers), and you'll own the quality bar that lets legal trust AI with language that carries real liability.

YOU WILL

- Set the vision and multi-quarter strategy for Contract Orchestration, with a clear, opinionated view of where we beat incumbent CLMs

- Ship AI that does the work: clause analysis, playbook-grounded redlines, contract generation, triage and routing, and metadata extraction accurate enough to trust

- Own the full lifecycle, from intake and negotiation to the repository, contract families, renewals, and contract-to-spend compliance

- Work directly with customers to ship features that reduce contract cycle times and increase contract visibility and compliance

- Build agents and own the AI quality bar end to end: evals, guardrails, and feedback loops

- Roll up your sleeves wherever the team needs it, from user research to reviewing extraction quality on a customer's contracts

QUALIFICATIONS

- 4 - 8+ years of Product Management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, owning ambiguous, high-impact areas end to end

- Deep experience partnering with engineering and design to ship sophisticated products with a great user experience

- Experience with workflow or document-heavy enterprise products

- A track record of setting product strategy and influencing cross-functional partners and leadership without direct authority

- Experience shipping AI or ML features where accuracy is non-negotiable, including how you measured and improved quality

- Strong written and verbal communication with internal and external stakeholders, including executives

- Extreme attention to detail, with the ability to quickly grasp complex business processes and industry knowledge

- Ability to prioritize ruthlessly, even if it may disappoint customers or stakeholders

Our vision is to grant the wish of every eligible child. Through our mission, we are uniting communities to grant life-changing wishes. As the world’s largest wish-granting organization, we strive to create a sense of community and an environment where we warmly embrace our wish families, volunteers, and colleagues.

Joining Make-A-Wish means becoming part of a mission that believes in the power of a wish.

Location:

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We do not sponsor employment visas or other immigration processes to attain or maintain employment eligibility.

Remote positions are open to applicants based anywhere in the continental U.S. Hybrid positions are open to applicants based in the Phoenix, Arizona area.

Position Summary:
As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will architect, design, build, and deliver technical solutions on the Make-A-Wish America Salesforce platform to support the Make-A-Wish National Office and chapters across the United States. This role will be part of the Salesforce -IT Applications team responsible for analyzing complex business problems and implementing solutions that will enhance the functionality of our growing business applications environment.
The ideal candidate will have a proven ability to deliver Salesforce applications and features and is a strategic problem solver to best meet Make-A-Wish’s needs. The role will deliver work within an agile framework. The role will also take responsibility for creating design specifications, developing unit test scripts for configuration and code, and preparing technical documentation.
This role will build and maintain positive relationships within internal technical teams, vendors, and product teams to deliver value. The position requires the ability to function successfully in both team and independent work environments to support the Make-A-Wish National Office and chapters across the United States.
Knowledge and Abilities:

• Salesforce development experience including configuration, customization, APEX, lightning web components, Triggers, Workflows, Approval processes, Reports and Dashboards.

• Strong analytical and product management skills with a keen sense to recommend optimal solution designs that is simple, secure, and adds value to Make-A-Wish’s goals.

• Experience implementing and administering Salesforce environments including understanding business needs, taking use cases/user stories and delivering features and functionality, assisting with solution development, testing, training and implementation support.

• Ability to build and maintain strong vendor partnerships to cohesively deliver value.

• Strong work ethic, integrity, and accountability mindset.

• Critical problem solving.

• Able to collaborate and communicate effectively with product teams and support teams.

Duties & Responsibilities:

• Custom User Interface development, including Visualforce/Lightning pages, Aura Components and Lightning Web Components

The Locums Recruiting Manager is a hands-on leader who drives recruiter performance. This role coaches and develops high-performing teams through clear expectations, data-driven insights, and thoughtful support, while serving as an escalation point as needed. The Manager partners closely with their team to optimize recruiting, solve challenges, and consistently exceed performance goals across the Locum Tenens staffing lifecycle.

We’re a $8+ billion dollar, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform.
At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally.

title: Vice President of Business Development - Remote
description:
The Vice President of Business Development is part of the Operations department, which residents on the Business Development team and reports to the Chief Operating Officer. As our Vice President of Business Development, you will build and scale CIS’s business opportunities and strategic partnerships across both commercial and government accounts, including cloud service providers and reseller channels. You will play a critical role in expanding market reach, developing high-value partner relationships, supporting strategic account growth, and driving revenue opportunities that align with CIS’s cybersecurity mission. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of the cybersecurity market, an extensive industry network, and the credibility to engage senior executives including CTOs, CISOs, and other decision-makers within partner and customer organizations. The Vice President of Business Development must also bring an entrepreneurial mindset, a builder mentality, and a strong track record of delivering measurable results. What You'll Do:

• Support engagement strategies for large enterprise accounts by identifying opportunities, building executive relationships, and advancing strategic sales motions

• Develop and execute a partnership strategy for cloud service providers (CSP), strategic technology alliances, and reseller ecosystems

• Identify, recruit, and grow relationships with key partners that can expand market access, accelerate pipeline development, and create long-term revenue opportunities

• Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior-level executives, including CTOs, CISOs, and other technical and business buyers across target organizations

• Represent CIS effectively in partner and enterprise customer discussions by articulating customer needs, cybersecurity market dynamics, and the differentiated value CIS brings to the market

• Work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to shape partner programs, go-to-market motions, value propositions, and joint engagement plans

• Engage and enable resellers to position CIS offerings effectively, identify target accounts, and support joint business development activities

• Translate market insights, partner feedback, and customer requirements into actionable recommendations that strengthen CIS strategy and commercial execution

• Create structure, processes, and reports for the business development function from the ground up while balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution

• Own CIS’s opportunity pipeline and contribute directly to measurable business outcomes, including partner-sourced opportunities, channel growth, strategic account engagement, and enterprise account influence

• Stay current on cybersecurity trends, buyer priorities, competitive developments, and cloud ecosystem changes that influence partnership strategy and enterprise demand

• Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a high-performing Business Development team

• Other tasks and responsibilities as assigned

What You'll Need:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Marketing, or related field*

• 8 - 10+ years of proven experience in business development, strategic partnerships, channel sales, or alliance management within cybersecurity, cloud, or enterprise technology markets

• 5+ years of experience leading, managing, coaching, and mentoring individuals and/or teams

• Demonstrated success building and growing partnerships with key customers and partners including cloud service providers, resellers, distributors, or other strategic channel partners

• Experience supporting or engaging large enterprise accounts and partnerships, including navigating complex stakeholder environments and long sales cycles

• Strong existing network across the cybersecurity and cloud ecosystem, with the ability to open doors and build credibility quickly

• Experience engaging executive-level stakeholders, including CTOs, CISOs, and other senior buyers, in complex enterprise environments

title: Director, Paid Social (Reddit Emphasis)
description:
Siege Media is a full-service GEO agency specializing in SEO, content marketing, digital PR, and affiliate marketing as a method of driving LLM visibility. We work with brands like Zapier, Asana, HP, PayPal, and Zoom. We're adding paid social to our service mix, with an emphasis in Reddit advertising to drive LLM influence for our clients. You'd own the channel. Perks for U.S. employees include 100% health, dental, and vision benefits, unlimited PTO, and remote-friendly work environments (with a preference for Austin or a willingness to travel for periodic team gatherings).
Siege Media values diversity. We encourage people of color, LGBTQIA+ folks, veterans, parents and those with disabilities to apply. We are committed to helping all people succeed at Siege. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete our application or interview process, please let us know.
The Role
This is a wedge hire. You're not joining an established paid social team - you're building one. On day one you own Reddit ads as a new client service line and run Siege's own paid social and retargeting. As Reddit ads books revenue, you'll hire and lead a team underneath you.
This is a senior, client-facing role. You'll pitch on sales calls, strategize campaigns, get hands-on in the platforms early in the lifespan of the service offering, and write the reports clients actually read. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys both strategy and execution. If you want to build a practice from scratch with the runway and brand of an established agency behind you, this role is for you.
Responsibilities

• Reddit Ads (Primary): Own strategy, setup, optimization, and reporting for Siege clients. Build the playbook, pricing scaffolds, and reporting cadence from zero.

• Siege's Paid Social: Retarget engaged leads and run Meta/LinkedIn campaigns that feed our own sales pipeline.

• Sales Support: Join prospect calls to scope and sell paid social engagements alongside the growth team.

• Team Building: Hire your first associate when Reddit ads revenue justifies it, then train and manage them to Siege's senior-led standard. Own and execute directly until then.

• Service Infrastructure: Develop the templates, QA processes, attribution approach, and reporting standards that turn paid social into a repeatable, sellable service line.

Required Skills

• 5+ years running paid social campaigns in an agency environment - ideally a mix of Reddit, LinkedIn, and Meta

• Hands-on Reddit Ads Manager experience (Conversation Ads, Promoted Posts, custom audiences) and a point of view on who the platform is and isn’t a fit for

• Proven B2B and B2C experience, especially within SaaS, e-commerce, and fintech. You know the difference between optimizing for clicks and optimizing for pipeline

• Demonstrated client-facing comfort - you can walk a VP of Marketing through a quarterly review without flinching

• Strong written communication. Clients see your work directly; we don't have account managers translating between you and them

• "Builder energy" and a genuine excitement about helping build and scale a service line from scratch. You can execute and advise on campaigns to keep the department profitable early on

Suggested Skills

• Experience with ChatGPT ads

• Prior experience building or scaling a paid social practice inside an agency environment

• Familiarity with B2B attribution headaches (multi-touch, dark social, self-reported attribution)

• An active client network in paid social within our client base

Compensation & Logistics

• Salary: $115,000.00-$130,000.00 USD base | $135,000.00-$155,000.00 USD OTE

• Benefits: Full benefits for employees, including 100% health/dental/vision, 401(k) matching and unlimited PTO

• Location: Remote-friendly, with a willingness to travel for periodic team gatherings

We’re building agentic recruiting software that rewrites how drivers get hired-and gives fleets a faster, smarter way to build their teams.
Trucking moves over 70% of the nation’s freight-but recruiting systems haven’t kept up. Fleets operate in a world of high-volume hiring, strict compliance requirements, high turnover, and urgency to fill roles fast-yet they’re still stuck with manual processes, disconnected tools, and slow qualification workflows.
Drivers fall through the cracks. Recruiters are buried in manual follow-ups. Hiring goals slip.
We’re here to change that. Our AI platform automates the most painful parts of recruiting-engaging applicants, gathering qualifications, and accelerating time-to-hire without cutting corners.

title: Head of CRO – Conversion Rate Optimization (m/w/d)
description:
stellenbeschreibung

Millions of people see our ads. Visit our landing pages. Browse our products. Add them to their carts.

Your job is to turn more of them into customers.

In just four years, Pammys has grown to more than 1 million customers . Today, over 150 employees are working to turn Pammys into an international footwear brand.

At our scale, even small improvements in conversion rate can have a significant impact on revenue.

That’s exactly why we’re building CRO as a dedicated function.

We’re looking for a Head of CRO - Conversion Rate Optimization (m/f/d) to systematically analyze, test, and optimize the entire customer journey across our online stores.

From the first landing page to PDP, cart, and checkout.

You’ll have high traffic volumes, large amounts of data, and the ability to test quickly.

No optimization based on gut feeling.

You develop hypotheses. You test. You measure. You learn. You scale what works.

And you’re not optimizing for the highest possible conversion rate alone.

You’re optimizing for profitable growth

deine aufgaben

• Build and own our entire CRO strategy, including the testing roadmap, prioritization, and reporting

• Design and manage A/B and multivariate tests across landing pages, PDPs, cart, and checkout

• Analyze our customer journey and funnels to identify the biggest conversion opportunities

• Develop and optimize landing pages for Meta, TikTok, influencer campaigns, product launches, and other campaigns

• Optimize offers, bundles, pricing, and promotional mechanics for both conversion and contribution margin

• Use GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and customer data to develop data-driven hypotheses

• Closely connect ads, hooks, landing pages, products, and offers together with Performance Marketing, Creative, and Product

• Build a robust experimentation framework with statistically valid tests and clearly documented learnings

• Over time, build and lead your own CRO team

dein profil

• At least 4 years of experience in CRO, Growth, or E-Commerce Optimization , ideally within a fast-scaling DTC or consumer brand

• Proven CRO success with measurable conversion or revenue uplifts that you personally owned

• Deep understanding of Shopify, e-commerce funnels, PDPs, landing pages, and checkout

• Strong experience with A/B testing and experimentation tools

• Confident using GA4, heatmaps, session recordings, and web analytics

• Solid statistical understanding of significance, sample sizes, and test duration

• Strong instinct for UX/UI, copy, offers, and consumer psychology

• Good understanding of unit economics, contribution margin, and profitability

• Ability to challenge Performance Marketing and Creative from a CRO perspective, with a strong understanding of Meta and TikTok traffic mechanics

• SQL, BI tools, or technical Shopify knowledge are a strong plus

• Extremely data-driven and structured, while maintaining a highly hands-on approach

• You don’t just want to analyze. You want to test, execute, and deliver measurable results

deine vorteile bei pammys

•
Massive Leverage: Even small CRO uplifts have a direct commercial impact at our traffic scale

•
Ownership: Build CRO at Pammys as a dedicated function from the ground up

•
Testing at Scale: High traffic volumes allow you to generate reliable test results and learnings faster

•
Direct Impact: Your work can be measured directly in conversion, revenue, and contribution margin

•
Team Building: Build and develop your own CRO organization over time

•
Speed: Short decision-making paths and close collaboration with Performance, Creative, and Product

•
Benefits: Attractive compensation, public transport subsidy, and corporate benefits

Drive the development and innovation of Flix's own ticket sales across Latin America, working hand in hand with local shop organizations and retail partners

• Act as the key liaison between regional shop partners and internal teams, ensuring alignment on goals, timelines, and execution

• Identify and pilot new sales concepts and workflows, then scale what works across markets

• Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced, agile environment

• Excellent analytical skills and comfort working with sales data and reporting tools to drive decisions

• Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across international teams and external partners

• A hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset ,as comfortable in the field with shop teams as in a strategy review

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Clinical Psychologist / Counselor (Massachusetts, US)
description:
Intellect Care (Counselling/ Psychotherapy) is a collaborative process to guide, explore and/or resolve personal, social, or psychological problems and difficulties.
Counselling is most useful when clients seek tools or techniques to support their mental health. Psychotherapy identifies unhelpful patterns of thinking and behaviours which may limit the client's quality of life or daily activities and equip clients with more helpful and effective ways of thinking, behaving and relating to others. This addresses moderately severe mental health experiences. Intellect Care normally spans up to 60 minutes
Why Join Us?
Become part of a collaborative network of Clinical Psychologists and Counsellors dedicated to expanding access to quality mental health care. At Intellect, you’ll find a supportive community focused on enhancing lives and helping clients overcome personal challenges.
What You'll Do

• Provide 1-on-1 telehealth/or onsite mental health support for Intellect’s clients

• Address a range of clinical cases, including depression, anxiety, trauma, schizophrenia, eating disorders, addiction, and more

• Partner with our internal clinical team to improve the platform and client programs

Requirements
For Counselors

• Hold an active Massachusetts Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) license

• Be licensed through the Massachusetts Board of Registration of Allied Mental Health and Human Services Professions

• Hold a Master’s degree in Counseling or a related field

• Have completed:

• 60 semester hours of graduate education

• 3,360 hours of post-master’s supervised experience over a minimum of 2 years

• Have passed the NCMHCE examination

For Psychologists

• Hold an active Massachusetts Psychologist license

• Be licensed through the Massachusetts Board of Registration of Psychologists

• Hold a doctoral degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) from an accredited program

• Have completed:

• 2 years of supervised experience

• At least 1 year of post-doctoral supervised practice

• Have passed:

• Examination for Professional Practice in Psychology (EPPP)

• Massachusetts jurisprudence examination

• Expertise: Skilled in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy or other evidence-based approaches (e.g., Motivational Interviewing, DBT, SFBT)

• Languages: Proficiency in English and your local language

• Preferred Background: Prior experience with EAP, adult counseling, or coaching in managerial roles

• Flexibility: Openness to ocassional onsite work, if necessary

Benefits
This is more than a job. It's your chance to:

• Work with a global provider network

• Broaden your clientele base beyond local users

• Grow your career outside of sessions through research, content, and webinars

• Access supervision & CE most EAP's don't provide

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact and be part of a mission-driven team, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join us in transforming mental health care!

Responsibilities

•
Investigate and resolve Salesforce-side integration issues, including data mappings, API-related configuration, permissions, field changes, and error triage.

•
Partner with business stakeholders to clarify operational needs and deliver practical, maintainable solutions.

•
Escalate material architecture, security, integration, or cross-system design decisions to the Enterprise Architect for review and guidance.

•
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, releases, known issues, and operational processes to ensure continuity throughout the engagement.

•
Take on limited, well-scoped enhancements when operational coverage is stable, and capacity allows.

title: Sales Development Representative - US Cold Calling
description:
About the role
Division 50 runs outbound sales development for our clients - companies across many different industries who hire us to fill their calendars with qualified meetings. As a US Cold Calling SDR, you sit on the phones every day calling into the US market on behalf of those clients. You learn each client's product, ideal customer, and pitch, then dial their target accounts, get past the brush-off, and book qualified meetings their closers actually show up for.
This is a phone-first role. You are not selling Division 50's own services - you represent our clients. The work changes as our client roster changes, so you ramp fast on new products and industries and keep your numbers steady through the switch. This is fully remote, working US business hours.
What you'll do

• Make high-volume cold calls into the US market on behalf of Division 50 clients across different industries (B2B SaaS, professional services, home services, healthcare, finance, and more)

• Learn each client's offer, ideal customer profile, and objection patterns quickly, and adapt your pitch to whoever you're calling that week

• Open cold calls that start with a brush-off, hold the line, and turn them into booked, qualified meetings

• Qualify prospects against each client's criteria before you book, so the meetings that land on a closer's calendar are real

• Log every dial, conversation, and booked meeting in the CRM so the client and your manager can see the activity

• Follow up on warm inbound leads for clients who run them - qualify, and book the meeting (this is a plus, not the core of the job)

• Hit daily dial and weekly meeting-booked targets, and keep them steady even when you switch to a new client or industry

What we're looking for

• Proven cold-calling experience dialing into the US market - you've spent your day on outbound phones and have the call volume to show for it

• A track record of booking qualified B2B meetings from cold dials, with real numbers (dials per day, meetings per week)

• You ramp fast on a new product or industry and can sound credible on the phone after a short briefing

• You handle the early brush-off - "not interested," "send me an email," "we're all set" - and keep the conversation alive

• Clear, confident spoken English and a natural phone manner US prospects respond to

• Disciplined with CRM hygiene and daily activity targets

• Comfortable with a smaller base + high uncapped commission tied to booked meetings

Nice to have

• Experience qualifying warm inbound leads as well as cold outbound

• Time spent in an agency, BPO, or outsourced-SDR setting where you carried multiple client accounts at once

• Familiarity with dialers, sales engagement tools, and CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, or similar)

• Experience calling into more than one industry or buyer type

About us & how to apply
Division 50 is a B2B lead generation and marketing agency. We run appointment-setting and outbound SDR programs for clients across many industries, alongside paid ads, SEO, and social media management. This SDR role sits inside our client-fulfillment team - the people who actually pick up the phone and book the meetings our clients pay us for.
To apply, complete the short application and screening questions. Strong applicants move to a conversation with Raffi, our AI recruiter, where we'll go deep on your cold-calling background. We hire for outbound skill and consistency, not industry pedigree.

Wir kaufen keine beliebigen Leadlisten und erwarten von dir auch keine hundert wahllosen Kaltanrufe am Tag. Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus diesen Signalen echte Gespräche zu machen.
Was du bei uns machst
Du übernimmst die operative Ansprache ausgewählter Unternehmen und begleitest einen Account so lange, bis klar ist, ob ein relevantes Thema für VIAMA besteht.
Dazu gehört insbesondere:

Du recherchierst die richtigen Ansprechpartner in unseren Zielunternehmen.
Du nimmst telefonisch Kontakt auf, auch über Zentralen und Assistenzbereiche.
Du führst erste Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, IT-Verantwortlichen und Verantwortlichen für Informationssicherheit.
Du findest heraus, wo das Unternehmen bei Themen wie NIS2, ISO 27001 oder TISAX tatsächlich steht.
Du erkennst, ob ein konkreter Bedarf besteht und wann der richtige Zeitpunkt für ein weiteres Gespräch ist.
Du hältst Wiedervorlagen konsequent nach und lässt interessante Accounts nicht einfach verschwinden.
Du dokumentierst die wesentlichen Erkenntnisse sauber im CRM.

title: Backend Engineer, Core Technology
description:
Who we are
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
Stripe Infrastructure is responsible for the reliability, scale, performance, and cost of Stripe 's systems and the productivity and sentiment of Stripe 's people.
You may work on a wide variety of critical business areas including:

• Core Infrastructure-We're the home for Stripe 's critical tier0 infrastructure systems (Compute, Networking, DocumentDB, Distributed Caching and High assurance engineering). We build the foundational platform for Stripe products and services to allow them to operate at scale. We drive reliability, availability, efficiency, and scalability of these systems.

• Developer Infrastructure-We're responsible for the productivity of all developers at Stripe . Ensure Stripe 's engineers have a reliable, fast, and easy-to-use inner dev loop to maximize productivity while building everything from low-latency microservices to large-scale data pipelines and machine learning models.

• Data Infrastructure-We're responsible for offering data serving infrastructure spanning across data warehouse analytics, streaming analytics, and search capabilities. The stack is supported by a collection of internally developed large-scale distributed services and several popular open-source technologies like Trino/Presto, Apache Pinot, Hive Metastore, ElasticSearch etc. The systems we own support all of the data serving needs of high-scale services and thousands of individual Stripe s across the company.

• Admin Platform-We empower Stripe s to quickly build secure and delightful internal products in service of their users.

• Service Platform-We enable engineering teams at Stripe to easily write and ship useful services that correctly, reliably, and efficiently leverage platform capabilities.

• Developer Productivity AI-We're responsible for doubling Stripe 's engineering velocity through effective use of LLMs. We own Minions, Stripe 's one-shot, end-to-end coding agents.

Team matching-exact team matching for one of the subteams will begin during final stages. Please note we may also consider you for different orgs based on your experience, location, etc. Find more information on our team matching process here.
What you'll do
You'll work on projects that span technologies, systems, and processes where you'll design, build, test, and ship great code every day.
Responsibilities

• Build a great customer experience for internal and external Stripe teams using our infrastructure

• Participate in roadmap planning and prioritization

• Deliver value through a strong collaborative approach with multiple customers and stakeholders across Stripe

• Debug production issues across services and several levels of the stack

Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements

• Strong software engineering skills and a passion for one of the areas above

• Ability to write high-quality code (in programming languages like Go, Java, C/C++ etc.)

• 2-12+ years of professional hands-on software development experience, able to write well-factored algorithms and have experience with commonly used data structures and algorithms

• Hands-on experience contributing to or building large-scale distributed systems

• Strong collaboration skills, can work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success

title: AI Enablement Specialist
description:
About Fullscript
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.
This is your invitation.
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Opportunity
Fullscript is looking for an AI Enablement Specialist to help Fullscripters use AI confidently, responsibly, and effectively in their day-to-day work.

You will join Team GSD, Fullscript's AI and automation enablement team. GSD helps departments improve how work gets done by combining practical AI education, workflow discovery, and scalable automation. This role will own the human side of that work: turning fast-moving AI capabilities and internal tools into clear, useful learning experiences that meet people where they are.
 
This is primarily a content, enablement, and adoption role. You will build the self-serve resources, interactive learning experiences, communications, and support models that help teams learn independently. You will also work with stakeholders to uncover workflow pain points, assess AI and automation opportunities, and translate what you learn into clear inputs for the GSD roadmap.
 
You will not be expected to build machine learning models or act as a full-time trainer. You should, however, be hands-on and credible with modern AI tools, curious about how people learn, and comfortable facilitating a live session or webinar when it is the best way to help a group move forward.
What you'll do
Own the creation of Fullscript’s AI training and development content, including practical guides, slide decks, blogs, videos, playbooks, templates, and role-based learning paths.
Build and continuously improve interactive, self-serve learning experiences that make Fullscript’s AI knowledge easy to find, understand, and apply independently.
Identify user groups, learning needs, and skill gaps across Fullscript, then tailor content to their workflows, business context, and level of AI fluency.
Stay current on AI tools, capabilities, use cases, and emerging trends, using that knowledge to keep Fullscript’s learning materials accurate, relevant, and practical.
Partner with AI Champions to shape departmental adoption roadmaps, equip them with reusable resources, and support the rollout and internal go-to-market of new AI tools.
Build strong relationships across the business, observe how teams work, and uncover operational pain points, knowledge gaps, and opportunities for AI or automation.
Gather requirements and frame opportunities by documenting the problem, users, current workflow, expected impact, data needs, feasibility, and risk, then translate those insights into clear recommendations for GSD roadmap planning.
Serve as a frontline enablement partner for GSD applications, turning recurring questions, adoption barriers, and user feedback into better content, product guidance, and roadmap inputs.
Measure and improve enablement through signals such as content engagement, tool usage, proficiency, support trends, time saved, and business impact.
Facilitate select workshops, webinars, office hours, or onboarding sessions, share useful practices across teams, and occasionally represent Fullscript at relevant industry events.
